about: The work's own word senses settled by hand (words.py, step 5): where the owner's draft gloss doubted the text or its sense, each read on the Gita Press print where the book has the Sanskrit (shiv-1, its scan page), else on the book's own Hindi (Kalyan 2018). "own": words the shared dictionary has, given the work's own gloss all the same, because their shared entries carry another work's reading (the Viṣṇu Sahasranāma's names: कामी "whose every desire is fulfilled", आदित्यो "son of Aditi, as Vāmana"); words.py keeps them until those senses move to that work's own glossary.
